name: ACT Agent
description: Executes recorded UI automation scripts as a test suite and returns an HTML report.

triggers.name: test_suite_tasks
triggers.description: A test-suite driven trigger that supplies test_suite_id and the ordered recording files to execute.

children.name: select_recordings
children.description: Select recording scripts to include in the test suite.

children.name: resume_from_run_id
children.description: Sequential mode only — paste a previous run ID to resume from its first failed recording. Leave empty to start fresh.

children.name: after_action_wait_ms
children.description: Milliseconds to wait after each action (settle time) before capturing the step. Leave empty to use the runner default. A per-recording value overrides this suite default.

children.name: debug_trace
children.description: Capture extra per-step runtime debug details in the action log and report.

children.name: debug_record_video
children.description: Record a video of the run and include it in the manifest when available.

children.name: debug_full_page_steps
children.description: Capture full-page step screenshots instead of viewport-only images.

children.name: debug_page_text_max_chars
children.description: Maximum page-text snapshot length to persist for diagnostics and report debugging.
